justification: Changes how the outside watchdog and Telegram are told about the daily alarm; the alarm's own checks are unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reuses the existing healthchecks.io check (secret HC_PING_FRESHNESS, period 2 d) and Telegram secrets already in the repo; no new vendor.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The workflow pinged only when every check was green; with 236 known red keys today it would never ping and would email every 2 days. Railway check returned 1 for both 'found problems' and 'could not look'.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new decision script; the three existing check steps now record exit codes instead of stopping the job.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a red result is not sent to Telegram, a crash/exit 2/failed Telegram send pings success, or 'OK (not found)' counts as landed
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The real-fixture test failed on the first draft: Railway job lines (dcp-commit: ...) were dropped from the message. Fixed. 9 hand mutants all killed.

functions.name: decide
functions.input: dict of check name to exit code text, plus whether Telegram delivered
functions.output: the string success or fail for the healthchecks.io ping
functions.if_none: a missing or empty exit code means the step crashed and returns fail

functions.name: message
functions.input: the exit codes and the saved text output of each check
functions.output: the Telegram text with headline lines capped at 25, or None
functions.if_none: None when every check exited 0, so nothing is sent

functions.name: send_telegram
functions.input: message text, bot token, chat id, injectable post function
functions.output: True only when Telegram answers ok true with a message id
functions.if_none: any exception or a missing message id returns False

functions.name: ping
functions.input: healthchecks.io URL, the verdict, injectable post function
functions.output: True only when the body starts OK and is not OK (not found)
functions.if_none: an unreachable host returns False and the job goes red

break_it.scenario: A check step crashes before it records an exit code
break_it.what_happens: silent: the old job treated it like red and simply did not ping
break_it.how: empty rc -> decide returns fail -> /fail ping -> email now

break_it.scenario: Telegram is down or the bot token was rotated and not updated
break_it.what_happens: silent: red is computed but nobody hears it
break_it.how: send_telegram must return ok+message_id, else /fail -> healthchecks.io emails

break_it.scenario: The healthchecks.io URL in the secret names no check
break_it.what_happens: silent: 200 'OK (not found)' looks like a ping
break_it.how: body checked; not found -> exit 1, job red

break_it.scenario: Railway API is down so the jobs check cannot look
break_it.what_happens: silent: exit 1 read as 'looked, found problems' and pinged success

mutation_analysis: 9 hand mutants on decide/send_telegram/ping/message (accept rc 2, Telegram None as ok, empty rcs, always success, ok OR message_id, ignore 'not found', no /fail suffix, drop job lines, wrong red code): 9 killed. Sol 2026-10-23: per-report line share (2 mutants killed, test now uses production report order) and ledger keeps 2/crash as 2 (7 exit-code combinations checked by hand).
residual_risk: The ledger mapping is shell inside the workflow, checked by hand on 7 combinations, not by pytest. Step 4 DONE WHEN (a 49 h pause producing one email) needs a manual test on healthchecks.io.

post_merge.manual_verify: workflow_dispatch freshness-alarm once: Telegram message arrives and healthchecks.io shows a success ping; then pause the check 49 h and confirm exactly one email.
